name: qExpansion_coeff_eq_circleIntegral
statement: ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h) (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f) (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hR' : R < 1) : (qExpansion h f).coeff n = ((2 * π * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), cuspFunction h f z / z ^ (n + 1))

name: qExpansion_coeff_eq_intervalIntegral
